A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work, An Undetectable Watermark for Generative Image Models. All 26 pages, including figures, tables, equations and Appendices A-D, support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v3 reports original image-quality, detectability, robustness and message-decoding experiments in Section 4 and Appendix A, plus a CelebA VAE experiment in Appendix D.

after.justification: v4 retains these original experiments and their outcomes, including Tables 1-2, the experimental figures and the Appendix D VAE results.

M1.justification: The PRC watermark construction, latent sampling, recovery, detection and message decoding are unchanged. Section 3 and Algorithms 1-8 in Appendices B-C are identical.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same MS-COCO and Stable Diffusion Prompts evaluations, PromptHero diversity prompts, attack scenarios and CelebA VAE demonstration. No dataset or task coverage changes.

E2.justification: The eight watermark baselines in Section 4.1 and comparator membership in individual tables and figures are unchanged. The newly cited Arabi et al. work is not added as an evaluated baseline.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendices A-D retain the same model configurations, sample sizes, metrics, sampling and inversion settings, attack strengths and testing procedures.

E4.justification: The robustness and supplementary analyses are identical, including detector-model and multiple-key tests, parity-sparsity sensitivity, detector-versus-decoder comparisons, spoofing attacks and image case studies.

E5.justification: Section 4.2 and Tables 1-2 retain the same standard-error reporting, five-fold cross-validation for FID and CLIP, LPIPS uncertainty estimates and three-standard-error highlighting. No run, seed or statistical reporting information changes.

E6.justification: Tables 1-2, Figures 1-15 and the accompanying numerical and qualitative findings are unchanged. Appendix D still reports over 90% TPR at FPR 0.05 for the CelebA VAE demonstration.

T1.justification: The undetectability and false-positive-rate theorems, mathematical assumptions, detector derivations and proofs in Section 3 and Appendices B-C are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same novelty, undetectability, quality-preservation, robustness and long-message-encoding claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations and limitations are unchanged, including Appendix C.3's warning about practical undetectability against motivated adversaries and Appendix D's qualification that VAE robustness and quality were not investigated in depth.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware, package disclosures and code/data access information are unchanged. Removed bibliography links concern cited publications, not implementation resources.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds Arabi et al. (2024), Hidden in the noise: Two-stage robust watermarking for images, to the existing Tree-Ring follow-up citations and bibliography. The surrounding discussion and novelty positioning remain unchanged.

P1.justification: Editorial changes update the arXiv version/date stamp and shorten bibliography entries by removing the Wen et al. publication URL and the Richard Zhang et al. DOI/URL. Apart from the added citation, prose and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: The added citation changes line wrapping in Section 2, and bibliography edits reflow entries across pages 11-13. All figures and tables retain identical content, captions, structure and placement.

improvement.justification: The additional Tree-Ring follow-up citation slightly broadens attribution but adds no substantive discussion or correction. Methods, evidence, proofs, reproducibility information and limitations are identical, including the appendices. The citation and bibliography edits do not meaningfully alter overall paper quality.
